intro_fa: spoken and lit) of 30 to 50 words
picture: then questions asking what and why.

round: # Written words as choices are short. From unit 14 the texts are in the past. Units 10 and 20 are longer review stories.

intro_fa: یک متن کوتاه دربارهٔ علی که مریض است. اول گوش کن و با آواز بخوان. بعد سه سوال می‌آید: چه و چرا.

say_en: Ali is not well today. He feels hot and tired. He is not hungry, but he is thirsty. His mother gives him water. Ali drinks the water and sleeps.
show_en: Ali is not well today. He feels hot and tired. He is not hungry, but he is thirsty. His mother gives him water. Ali drinks the water and sleeps.

wrong_say_fa: نه. دوباره بخوان: He feels hot and tired. علی گرمی می‌کند و مانده است.

say_en: What does his mother give him?
show_en: What does his mother give him?
wrong_say_fa: نه. مادرش به او آب می‌دهد: His mother gives him water.

choices: t:He is hungry|t:He is cold|t:He is thirsty
wrong_say_fa: نه. علی تشنه است، پس آب می‌نوشد: He is thirsty.

intro_fa: مینا با توپ بازی می‌کند و بعد جایی از بدنش درد می‌کند. بخوان و ببین که کجا، و چرا می‌نشیند.

say_en: Mina plays with a ball in the yard. She runs fast. Now her knee hurts and her back hurts. She sits down under the tree. Her brother brings water. ""Thank you,"" says Mina.
show_en: Mina plays with a ball in the yard. She runs fast. Now her knee hurts and her back hurts. She sits down under the tree. Her brother brings water. ""Thank you,"" says Mina.

wrong_say_fa: نه. دوباره بخوان: Now her knee hurts. زانوی مینا درد می‌کند.

choices: t:Her knee hurts|t:She is hungry|t:It is night
wrong_say_fa: نه. مینا می‌نشیند چون زانو و کمرش درد می‌کند.
نه. برادرش آب می‌آورد: Her brother brings water.

intro_fa: امروز تمام فامیل در خانه است، چون چند نفر مریض هستند. بخوان که کی چه مریضی دارد و کی جور است.

say_en: Today the family is at home. Father has a headache. Little Sara has a cough and a cold. Grandmother has no fever. She is well. She cooks rice for the family. They eat and rest.
show_en: Today the family is at home. Father has a headache. Little Sara has a cough and a cold. Grandmother has no fever. She is well. She cooks rice for the family. They eat and rest.

wrong_say_fa: نه. دوباره بخوان: Father has a headache. پدر سردرد دارد.
نه. مادرکلان تب ندارد. او جور است: She is well.

say_en: Why is the family at home?
show_en: Why is the family at home?
choices: t:It is Friday|t:They are sick|t:It is night
wrong_say_fa: نه. پدر سردرد دارد و سارا سرفه دارد. آنها مریض هستند، پس در خانه هستند.

intro_fa: متنی دربارهٔ کلینیک قریه. بخوان که کی در آنجا کار می‌کند و چرا مردم به کلینیک می‌روند.

say_en: Our village has a small clinic. A doctor and a nurse work there. Sick people go to the clinic. They wait in the yard. The doctor looks at every child. The nurse has bandages and a thermometer. They help us.
show_en: Our village has a small clinic. A doctor and a nurse work there. Sick people go to the clinic. They wait in the yard. The doctor looks at every child. The nurse has bandages and a thermometer. They help us.

wrong_say_fa: نه. دوباره بخوان: A doctor and a nurse work there. داکتر و نرس در کلینیک کار می‌کنند.
نه. مردم در حویلی منتظر می‌مانند: They wait in the yard.

say_en: Why do people go to the clinic?
show_en: Why do people go to the clinic?
choices: t:They are sick|t:They are late|t:They buy tea
wrong_say_fa: نه. مردم مریض به کلینیک می‌روند: Sick people go to the clinic.

intro_fa: رویا گوش‌درد دارد و پیش داکتر می‌رود. بخوان که داکتر به او چه می‌گوید. فرمان‌ها را می‌شناسی.

say_en: Roya has an earache. The doctor says: ""Sit down here. Don't move."" She looks in Roya's ear. Then she says: ""Open your mouth. Breathe in. Breathe out. Good! Come back tomorrow."" Roya is not afraid. The doctor is kind.
show_en: Roya has an earache. The doctor says: ""Sit down here. Don't move."" She looks in Roya's ear. Then she says: ""Open your mouth. Breathe in. Breathe out. Good! Come back tomorrow."" Roya is not afraid. The doctor is kind.

say_en: Where does the doctor look first?
show_en: Where does the doctor look first?
wrong_say_fa: نه. رویا گوش‌درد دارد. داکتر اول در گوش او می‌بیند: She looks in Roya's ear.
نه. داکتر گفت Come back tomorrow: فردا باز بیا.

choices: t:She is big|t:She is kind|t:The doctor is kind
wrong_say_fa: نه. رویا نمی‌ترسد چون داکتر مهربان است: The doctor is kind.

intro_fa: هر خانه قاعده‌هایی دارد. بخوان که در این خانه چه باید کرد و چه نباید کرد، و چرا.

say_en: In our house we have rules. We must wash our hands with soap before we eat. We must drink clean water. Small children must not play near the fire. We must not touch the matches. The rules keep us well.
show_en: In our house we have rules. We must wash our hands with soap before we eat. We must drink clean water. Small children must not play near the fire. We must not touch the matches. The rules keep us well.

say_en: What must we do before we eat?
show_en: What must we do before we eat?
wrong_say_fa: نه. دوباره بخوان: We must wash our hands with soap before we eat.
نه. ما نباید به گوگرد دست بزنیم: We must not touch the matches.

choices: t:to play|t:to be well|t:to be sad
wrong_say_fa: نه. قاعده‌ها برای این است که ما جور بمانیم: The rules keep us well.

intro_fa: حمید ریزش دارد، اما می‌خواهد در برف بازی کند. بخوان که خواهرش چه مشوره می‌دهد.

say_en: Hamid has a cold. He wants to play in the snow. His sister says: ""You should not go out today. It is very cold. You should stay at home and rest. You should drink tea."" Hamid stays at home. Tomorrow he can play.
show_en: Hamid has a cold. He wants to play in the snow. His sister says: ""You should not go out today. It is very cold. You should stay at home and rest. You should drink tea."" Hamid stays at home. Tomorrow he can play.

wrong_say_fa: نه. حمید می‌خواهد در برف بازی کند: He wants to play in the snow.
نه. خواهرش گفت You should drink tea: بهتر است که چای بنوشی.

say_en: Why should Hamid stay at home?
show_en: Why should Hamid stay at home?
choices: t:He is late|t:He has a cold|t:It is hot
wrong_say_fa: نه. حمید ریزش دارد و هوا بسیار سرد است، پس بهتر است که در خانه بماند.

intro_fa: یوسف خُرد می‌افتد. خواهرش لیلا با او است. بخوان و خودت تصمیم بگیر که لیلا چه کند.

say_en: Laila and her little brother Yusuf walk to the well. Yusuf runs. He falls on a stone. His knee hurts and he cries. Nobody is near.
show_en: Laila and her little brother Yusuf walk to the well. Yusuf runs. He falls on a stone. His knee hurts and he cries. Nobody is near.

wrong_say_fa: نه. یوسف خُرد است و افگار شده است. لیلا باید پیش او بماند و کمک بخواهد.

say_en: Laila stays with Yusuf. She shouts: ""Help! My brother is hurt!"" A woman comes. ""Are you all right?"" she asks. She helps Yusuf. They walk home slowly.
show_en: Laila stays with Yusuf. She shouts: ""Help! My brother is hurt!"" A woman comes. ""Are you all right?"" she asks. She helps Yusuf. They walk home slowly.

wrong_say_fa: نه. لیلا صدا می‌کند Help: کمک!

choices: t:His knee hurts|t:He is hungry|t:He is late
wrong_say_fa: نه. یوسف افتاد و زانویش درد می‌کند: His knee hurts.

intro_fa: یک دختر قریهٔ خود را نشان می‌دهد. بخوان که هر جای کجا است: نزدیک، دور، پشت، بین.

say_en: This is my village. The school is near the river. The bakery is between the school and the shop. The clinic is behind the bakery. The well is in front of my house. The bazaar is far. We go there on Friday.
show_en: This is my village. The school is near the river. The bakery is between the school and the shop. The clinic is behind the bakery. The well is in front of my house. The bazaar is far. We go there on Friday.

say_en: What is between the school and the shop?
show_en: What is between the school and the shop?
wrong_say_fa: نه. دوباره بخوان: The bakery is between the school and the shop.
نه. کلینیک پشت نانوایی است: The clinic is behind the bakery.

say_en: Why do they go to the bazaar only on Friday?
show_en: Why do they go to the bazaar only on Friday?
choices: t:It is near|t:It is far|t:It is small
wrong_say_fa: نه. بازار دور است: The bazaar is far. پس هر روز نمی‌روند.

intro_fa: این قصهٔ تکرار است: هر چه در نُه درس یاد گرفتی در آن می‌آید. عمر مریض است و به کلینیک می‌رود. دو صفحه بخوان و به سوال‌ها جواب بده.

say_en: Omar gets up. He feels hot and his head hurts. He has a fever. His father says: ""You must not go to school today. We go to the clinic."" The clinic is near. It is behind the school.
show_en: Omar gets up. He feels hot and his head hurts. He has a fever. His father says: ""You must not go to school today. We go to the clinic."" The clinic is near. It is behind the school.

wrong_say_fa: نه. دوباره بخوان: He has a fever. عمر تب دارد.
نه. کلینیک نزدیک است، پشت مکتب: It is behind the school.

say_en: At the clinic the nurse says: ""Wait here, please."" Then the doctor says: ""Open your mouth. Breathe in."" She says: ""Omar, you should rest and drink water. Come back tomorrow."" Omar says: ""Thank you, doctor.""
show_en: At the clinic the nurse says: ""Wait here, please."" Then the doctor says: ""Open your mouth. Breathe in."" She says: ""Omar, you should rest and drink water. Come back tomorrow."" Omar says: ""Thank you, doctor.""

wrong_say_fa: نه. نرس می‌گوید Wait here, please: لطفاً اینجا منتظر باش.
نه. داکتر گفت You should rest and drink water: بهتر است که استراحت کنی و آب بنوشی.

say_en: Why must Omar not go to school today?
show_en: Why must Omar not go to school today?
choices: t:He is sick|t:It is Friday|t:He is late
wrong_say_fa: نه. عمر تب دارد. او مریض است، پس نباید به مکتب برود.

intro_fa: نوید در قریه نو است و راه نانوایی را نمی‌داند. بخوان که چطور می‌رود: مستقیم، چپ یا راست.

say_en: Navid is new in the village. He asks a girl: ""How do I get to the bakery?"" She says: ""Go straight. Cross the bridge. Then turn right. The bakery is on the left, next to the school."" Navid walks five minutes. He sees the bakery!
show_en: Navid is new in the village. He asks a girl: ""How do I get to the bakery?"" She says: ""Go straight. Cross the bridge. Then turn right. The bakery is on the left, next to the school."" Navid walks five minutes. He sees the bakery!

wrong_say_fa: نه. دختر گفت Cross the bridge: از پل تیر شو.

say_en: Which way does he go after the bridge?
show_en: Which way does he go after the bridge?
wrong_say_fa: نه. بعد از پل: Then turn right، به دست راست.

say_en: Why does Navid ask the way?
show_en: Why does Navid ask the way?
choices: t:He is new|t:He is tired|t:He is sick
wrong_say_fa: نه. نوید در قریه نو است و راه را نمی‌داند: Navid is new in the village.

intro_fa: هوا صبح ابری است. بخوان که چرا شیرین خشک می‌ماند و دوستش تر می‌شود.

say_en: It is morning. It is cloudy and windy. Mother says: ""Take the umbrella, Shirin."" At lunch time it is raining. Shirin has her umbrella. Her friend has no umbrella. She is wet. The two girls walk home under the umbrella.
show_en: It is morning. It is cloudy and windy. Mother says: ""Take the umbrella, Shirin."" At lunch time it is raining. Shirin has her umbrella. Her friend has no umbrella. She is wet. The two girls walk home under the umbrella.

say_en: What is the weather like in the morning?
show_en: What is the weather like in the morning?
wrong_say_fa: نه. دوباره بخوان: It is cloudy and windy. صبح هوا ابری و بادی است.
نه. مادر گفت Take the umbrella: چتری را بگیر.
نه. باران می‌بارد و دوستش چتری ندارد: Her friend has no umbrella.

intro_fa: متنی دربارهٔ چهار فصل سال، در دو صفحه. بخوان که در هر فصل هوا چطور است.

say_en: A year has four seasons. In spring it rains and the trees have flowers. It is warm. In summer it is hot and dry. The fruit is sweet. We eat melons and grapes.
show_en: A year has four seasons. In spring it rains and the trees have flowers. It is warm. In summer it is hot and dry. The fruit is sweet. We eat melons and grapes.

say_en: What do the trees have in spring?
show_en: What do the trees have in spring?
wrong_say_fa: نه. دوباره بخوان: In spring the trees have flowers. در بهار درخت‌ها گل دارند.

say_en: In autumn the leaves are yellow and it is windy. In winter it is very cold. It snows and there is ice on the river. We wear coats and hats. Then spring comes again.
show_en: In autumn the leaves are yellow and it is windy. In winter it is very cold. It snows and there is ice on the river. We wear coats and hats. Then spring comes again.

wrong_say_fa: نه. در خزان برگ‌ها زرد است: In autumn the leaves are yellow.

say_en: What is on the river in winter?
show_en: What is on the river in winter?
wrong_say_fa: نه. در زمستان روی دریا یخ است: There is ice on the river.

say_en: Why do we wear coats in winter?
show_en: Why do we wear coats in winter?
choices: t:It is cold|t:It is dry|t:It is hot
wrong_say_fa: نه. در زمستان هوا بسیار سرد است، پس بالاپوش می‌پوشیم.

intro_fa: این متن از دیروز و امروز گپ می‌زند. به was و were نگاه کن: آنها دیروز را نشان می‌دهند.

say_en: Yesterday it was cold and rainy. The children were at home. They were not happy. The yard was wet. Today it is sunny and warm. The children are in the yard. They play with a ball. They are happy.
show_en: Yesterday it was cold and rainy. The children were at home. They were not happy. The yard was wet. Today it is sunny and warm. The children are in the yard. They play with a ball. They are happy.

wrong_say_fa: نه. دوباره بخوان: The children were at home. دیروز اطفال در خانه بودند.

say_en: What is the weather like today?
show_en: What is the weather like today?
wrong_say_fa: نه. امروز آفتابی و گرم است: Today it is sunny and warm.

say_en: Why were the children not happy?
show_en: Why were the children not happy?
choices: t:It was hot|t:It was rainy|t:It was late
wrong_say_fa: نه. دیروز باران می‌بارید و اطفال بیرون بازی کرده نمی‌توانستند.

intro_fa: سارا دیروز بسیار کار کرد. به فعل‌هایی که ed دارند نگاه کن: cleaned، washed، cooked. اینها کارهای دیروز است.

say_en: Yesterday was Friday. Sara helped her mother. In the morning she cleaned the room and washed the cups. Her mother cooked rice. In the afternoon Sara walked to her friend's house. They played in the yard. It rained in the evening and Sara stayed at home.
show_en: Yesterday was Friday. Sara helped her mother. In the morning she cleaned the room and washed the cups. Her mother cooked rice. In the afternoon Sara walked to her friend's house. They played in the yard. It rained in the evening and Sara stayed at home.

wrong_say_fa: نه. دوباره بخوان: She washed the cups. سارا پیاله‌ها را شست.
نه. مادرش برنج پخت: Her mother cooked rice.

say_en: Why did Sara stay at home in the evening?
show_en: Why did Sara stay at home in the evening?
choices: t:She was sick|t:It rained|t:It was hot
wrong_say_fa: نه. شام باران بارید: It rained in the evening. پس سارا در خانه ماند.

intro_fa: جواد هفتهٔ پیش دندان‌درد داشت. در دو صفحه بخوان که چه شد. فعل‌های گذشته را ببین: had، ate، drank، went، saw، came.

say_en: Last week Jawad had a toothache. He ate nothing. He drank only water. He slept badly. His father saw him and said: ""We go to the clinic tomorrow.""
show_en: Last week Jawad had a toothache. He ate nothing. He drank only water. He slept badly. His father saw him and said: ""We go to the clinic tomorrow.""

wrong_say_fa: نه. دوباره بخوان: Jawad had a toothache. جواد دندان‌درد داشت.

choices: t:His tooth hurt|t:He was full|t:He was late
wrong_say_fa: نه. دندانش درد می‌کرد، پس چیزی خورده نمی‌توانست.

say_en: In the morning they went to the clinic. The doctor saw the tooth. She helped Jawad. In the evening he came home and ate rice. He slept well that night. He was happy.
show_en: In the morning they went to the clinic. The doctor saw the tooth. She helped Jawad. In the evening he came home and ate rice. He slept well that night. He was happy.

say_en: Where did they go in the morning?
show_en: Where did they go in the morning?
wrong_say_fa: نه. صبح به کلینیک رفتند: They went to the clinic.

say_en: What did Jawad eat in the evening?
show_en: What did Jawad eat in the evening?
wrong_say_fa: نه. شام به خانه آمد و برنج خورد: He ate rice.

intro_fa: مینا بز را به صحرا برد، اما شام بدون بز به خانه آمد. در دو صفحه بخوان که بز کجا بود. به Did و didn't نگاه کن.

say_en: Yesterday Mina took the goat to the field. In the evening she came home. Her father asked: ""Did you bring the goat?"" ""Oh no! I didn't,"" said Mina.
show_en: Yesterday Mina took the goat to the field. In the evening she came home. Her father asked: ""Did you bring the goat?"" ""Oh no! I didn't,"" said Mina.

say_en: Did Mina bring the goat home?
show_en: Did Mina bring the goat home?
wrong_say_fa: نه. مینا گفت I didn't: او بز را نیاورد.

say_en: They went back to the field. They didn't see the goat. Did it go to the river? No, it didn't. Then Mina heard it. The goat was behind a big tree. It ate leaves!
show_en: They went back to the field. They didn't see the goat. Did it go to the river? No, it didn't. Then Mina heard it. The goat was behind a big tree. It ate leaves!

choices: t:behind a tree|t:in the river|t:at home
wrong_say_fa: نه. بز پشت یک درخت کلان بود: The goat was behind a big tree.
نه. بز برگ می‌خورد: It ate leaves.

say_en: Why did they go back to the field?
show_en: Why did they go back to the field?
choices: t:to play|t:to find the goat|t:to sleep
wrong_say_fa: نه. مینا بز را نیاورده بود. آنها رفتند که بز را پیدا کنند.

intro_fa: کریم امروز صبح بسیار کار کرد. بخوان که اول چه کرد، بعد چه، و بعد از آن چه.

say_en: This morning Karim got up early. First he washed his face and hands. Then he ate bread and drank tea. After that he carried water from the well. Before school he gave food to the hens. After school he was tired, but he was happy.
show_en: This morning Karim got up early. First he washed his face and hands. Then he ate bread and drank tea. After that he carried water from the well. Before school he gave food to the hens. After school he was tired, but he was happy.

wrong_say_fa: نه. دوباره بخوان: First he washed his face and hands. اول روی و دست‌هایش را شست.

say_en: What did he do before school?
show_en: What did he do before school?
choices: t:He slept|t:He played|t:He fed the hens
wrong_say_fa: نه. پیش از مکتب به مرغ‌ها دانه داد: He gave food to the hens.

say_en: Why was Karim tired after school?
show_en: Why was Karim tired after school?
choices: t:He worked a lot|t:He was sick|t:It was hot
wrong_say_fa: نه. کریم از صبح وقت بسیار کار کرد، پس مانده شد.

intro_fa: یک همسایهٔ پیر مریض بود و دو طفل به او کمک کردند. در دو صفحه بخوان که چه کردند و چرا.

say_en: Our neighbour is an old woman. She lives next to our house. Last winter she was sick. She had a cough and she was cold. She was in bed all day.
show_en: Our neighbour is an old woman. She lives next to our house. Last winter she was sick. She had a cough and she was cold. She was in bed all day.

wrong_say_fa: نه. دوباره بخوان: She had a cough. همسایه سرفه داشت.

say_en: My brother and I visited her. We brought soup and a blanket. My brother carried firewood. I cooked tea. After a week she was better. She said: ""You are kind children.""
show_en: My brother and I visited her. We brought soup and a blanket. My brother carried firewood. I cooked tea. After a week she was better. She said: ""You are kind children.""

wrong_say_fa: نه. برادرم هیزم برد: My brother carried firewood.
نه. آنها شوربا و یک کمپل آوردند: We brought soup and a blanket.

say_en: Why did the children visit her?
show_en: Why did the children visit her?
choices: t:She was sick|t:She was rich|t:It was Friday
wrong_say_fa: نه. همسایه پیر و مریض بود، پس اطفال به کمک او رفتند.

intro_fa: این قصهٔ آخر است، در سه صفحه: هوا، راه، کلینیک و کمک، همه با هم. لیلا و برادرش علی در یک صبح زمستان به مکتب می‌روند.

say_en: Last winter it snowed all night. In the morning the road was white. Laila and her brother Ali walked to school. It was very cold and windy.
show_en: Last winter it snowed all night. In the morning the road was white. Laila and her brother Ali walked to school. It was very cold and windy.

wrong_say_fa: نه. دوباره بخوان: It snowed all night. تمام شب برف بارید.

say_en: On the bridge there was ice. Ali fell. His arm hurt. Laila shouted: ""Help!"" A man came. He said: ""Don't move. The clinic is near. Go straight and turn left.""
show_en: On the bridge there was ice. Ali fell. His arm hurt. Laila shouted: ""Help!"" A man came. He said: ""Don't move. The clinic is near. Go straight and turn left.""
